title: Standard Mission
description: The festive classic for any occasion

comboRules.title: 420 — Jackpot!
comboRules.text: You rolled the legendary 420! Round trophy. You are the king or queen of this table.

comboRules.title: Triple Heart
comboRules.text: Kiss the person on your left on the forehead. If they refuse, they take the challenge instead.
comboRules.characterComment: Awwww! Love is in the air tonight!

comboRules.title: Total Fog
comboRules.text: Everyone blows slowly together and pretends they cannot see anything for 10 seconds. Complete silence.
comboRules.characterComment: Zero visibility. I can't see a thing. Who are you?

comboRules.title: Absolute Prohibited
comboRules.text: Everyone admits out loud something they are not supposed to do but still do anyway.
comboRules.characterComment: Triple forbidden. The table judges. The table condemns.

comboRules.title: Triple Four
comboRules.text: Invent an absurd rule that applies for the next 3 rounds. The group votes on whether it stays.
comboRules.characterComment: Three fours... The rules bend to your will!

comboRules.title: Double Duplicate
comboRules.text: Tell a truth you did not plan to reveal tonight. Or take two sips if you refuse.
comboRules.characterComment: Two times two times two... Talk or pay!

comboRules.title: The Void
comboRules.text: Absolute silence. Nobody talks, moves or smiles for 10 seconds. Trophy of emptiness.

comboRules.title: Triangle of Awkwardness
comboRules.text: Everyone points at the most suspicious person at the table. Whoever gets the most fingers takes a challenge.
comboRules.characterComment: Love, mystery and forbidden things. The perfect triangle of chaos.

comboRules.title: Smoky Romance
comboRules.text: Say the name of your latest crush. If you refuse, imitate someone at the table for 1 minute.
comboRules.characterComment: Four, heart, cloud... Love is floating around tonight.

comboRules.title: Administrative Incident
comboRules.text: Recite the rules from memory. If you get more than two things wrong, take a drink.
comboRules.characterComment: Two, forbidden, zero... Good luck with that.

comboRules.title: Four-Two Heart
comboRules.text: Say something sincere to the person opposite you. No jokes. Something real.

comboRules.title: Four in the Fog
comboRules.text: Describe your favourite film without saying its title or genre. The group has to guess it.

comboRules.title: Forbidden Love
comboRules.text: Confess a secret attraction, real or fictional. Celebrity, TV character... everything counts.

comboRules.title: Two Hearts in the Clouds
comboRules.text: Give a sincere compliment to everyone around the table. One sentence each, quickly.

comboRules.title: Zero Love Forbidden
comboRules.text: Tell the worst romantic date you have ever had. If you have none, invent a believable one.

comboRules.title: Four-Four-Two
comboRules.text: The group votes: you must do an impression. They choose who at the table you imitate.

comboRules.title: Double Four Zero
comboRules.text: Ask a question you would normally never dare to ask. Anyone at the table may answer... or not.

comboRules.title: Two Two Heart
comboRules.text: Swap seats with someone at the table. Your new neighbours count for the next rounds.

comboRules.title: Double Fog
comboRules.text: Talk for 30 seconds about a subject you know nothing about while pretending to be an expert. Nobody may laugh.

comboRules.title: Two Times Zero
comboRules.text: You may use no more than 2 words in your answers to the next 3 questions you are asked.

comboRules.title: Absolute Romantic Zero
comboRules.text: Write a love haiku in 10 seconds. The group scores it out of 5.

comboRules.title: The Foggy Void
comboRules.text: Describe the strangest thing you have ever eaten. If it is genuinely strange, you win a challenge to give away.

comboRules.title: Zero Forbidden
comboRules.text: Reveal something you did that you clearly should not have done. The table cheers or boos.

comboRules.title: Four-Two Forbidden
comboRules.text: Make an absurd bet with the person on your right. If you lose it tonight, you take a double challenge.

comboRules.title: Love in the Fog
comboRules.text: Mime a romantic movie scene without speaking. The group has to guess the film.

comboRules.title: Double Empty Love
comboRules.text: Make the most theatrical declaration of love possible to an object in the room. Get on one knee if you can.

comboRules.title: Double Forbidden Love
comboRules.text: Admit something you love even though you know perfectly well it is bad for you.

comboRules.title: Fog Zero
comboRules.text: Keep your eyes closed for 20 seconds while the group hides an object. You have 1 minute to find it.

comboRules.title: Romantic Cloud
comboRules.text: Invent an absurd excuse for missing a date. The less believable, the better.

comboRules.title: Forbidden Fog
comboRules.text: Tell a completely invented rumour about yourself as if it were true. The group may ask 3 questions.

comboRules.title: Romantic Forbidden
comboRules.text: Say what you would do if you had a superpower for 24 hours. The most creative answer wins a drink.

comboRules.title: Double Foggy Forbidden
comboRules.text: Whisper something into the ear of the person on your right that nobody else should know. They decide whether it is true.

comboRules.title: Double Forbidden Void
comboRules.text: You must say 'yes' to the next reasonable request made to you tonight. No conditions.

comboRules.title: Four Forbidden Fogs
comboRules.text: Imagine you are CEO of an absurd company. Pitch it to investors in 30 seconds.

comboRules.title: Two Zero Heart
comboRules.text: Bow theatrically to everyone at the table and say 'thank you for existing'. Do not laugh.

comboRules.title: Two Forbidden Fogs
comboRules.text: Invent a cocktail with 3 unlikely ingredients. Give it a name worthy of a Parisian bar.

comboRules.title: Four Zero Forbidden
comboRules.text: Go around the table shaking everyone's hand very formally, as if you were in a business meeting.

comboRules.title: Four Zero Heart
comboRules.text: Sing at least 10 seconds of a love song. The person on your left chooses the song.

comboRules.title: Two-Four in the Clouds
comboRules.text: Create a 30-second sketch about 'an astronaut ordering a pizza'. You play every role.

comboRules.title: Zero Cloud Heart
comboRules.text: The group asks a question. You must answer by singing; musical talent is optional, effort counts.
